description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a code formatter for .gn files, including functions for parsing, formatting, and outputting formatted code with style considerations.

classes.name: Printer
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting and printing parse trees of .gn files with style and indentation.

methods.name: Printer::Block
methods.description: Formats a block node, handling comments, sorting imports, and formatting statements.

methods.name: Printer::String
methods.description: Returns the formatted output as a string.

methods.name: Printer::Expr
methods.description: Formats an expression node, handling operator precedence, comments, and line breaking.

methods.name: DoFormat
methods.description: Main function to format a parse tree into a string, optionally dumping the parse tree.

methods.name: FormatStringToString
methods.description: Tokenizes and parses input string, then formats it into output string.

methods.name: RunFormat
methods.description: Entry point for the 'gn format' command, handling command-line arguments, file I/O, and invoking formatting.
